text.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

words.gloss_range: deterrent and rebuking response particle, with an affirming threat-opening force in this position
words.prose: {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) does not open the ayah as a neutral transition. It rebukes the conduct exposed in 96:9-14, closes the previous question as accusation after 96:14, and launches the sworn threat that follows. The particle also belongs to the surah's repeated stop-pattern: after the earlier occurrence at 96:6, this second occurrence introduces the threat block, while 96:19 will answer with final command. Its doubled middle and open ending make the halt audible before the conditional begins.

topics.headline: rebuke also opens confirmed consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a rebuking halt that also prepares the confirmed threat, not as simple negation.
topics.reason: QAC gives deterrent force as the local grammar, while the CRITICAL rows' affirmation claim survives as the particle's prospective opening of the oath-threat rather than as a replacement for rebuke.

topics.headline: question closes into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior question after 96:14 stop hanging as inquiry and become the threshold of a sworn consequence.
topics.reason: The word stands before the sworn conditional frame, and the boundary rows coherently connect it to the preceding interrogative accusation.

topics.headline: second stop escalates the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is the second of the surah's three deterrent stops, moving from diagnosis at 96:6 to threat at 96:15 and then command at 96:19.
topics.reason: The recurrence at 96:6, 96:15, and 96:19 is concrete and compatible with the QAC note that this is the second occurrence.

topics.headline: sound profile performs the stop
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the particle's tight middle and open release enact the pause before the threat frame moves forward.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the actual surface particle and reinforces the already established deterrent function.

words.gloss_range: oath prefix attached to the conditional opening
words.prose: The first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) makes the condition begin inside an implied oath frame. The refusal to desist remains conditional, but the speech is not casual or merely hypothetical: the warning is sworn from its first particle. Because this prefix is answered by the later {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) before the seizure verb, the ayah builds a paired frame rather than placing all force on the final action alone.

topics.headline: condition starts under oath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is open in trigger but sworn in authority from its first prefix.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks a compressed implied oath frame and a conditional protasis, matching the CRITICAL claim that this prefix scopes the condition.

topics.headline: oath force is fused to the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that oath force is not a separate preface but is attached to the conditional unit itself.
topics.reason: The QAC table treats the prefix and the following conditional particle as the formulaic sworn-conditional construction.

topics.headline: first prefix awaits its answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first oath prefix set up the matching answer-prefix that opens the apodosis.
topics.reason: The clause evidence separates protasis and apodosis while the two oath prefixes audibly and syntactically bind them.

words.gloss_range: open conditional particle inside the sworn construction
words.prose: {{ar:ئِن}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) keeps the warning grammatically conditional: the threat is triggered if non-desistance continues, not stated as an already unconditional clause. At the same time, because it is fused with the preceding oath prefix, the condition is carried in a sworn frame. The small catch of the hamza marks the turn from rebuke into the conditional middle of the ayah.

topics.headline: condition remains open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that desistance remains grammatically open, while refusal is bound to consequence.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as an open conditional, and the attachment evidence makes words 2-5 the protasis.

topics.headline: contingency and oath compress together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees solemn oath force and contingency compressed into one opening unit.
topics.reason: The implied oath frame does not cancel the condition; it heightens the pragmatic force of the conditional particle.

topics.headline: middle clause gate opens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from the opening rebuke into the structured condition that will receive an answer.
topics.reason: The particle's clause role and surface hamza both support the transition from deterrent opening to protasis.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator governing the desistance verb inside the condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes the condition negative and visibly changes the following verb into its clipped jussive form. In the sworn conditional frame, the negation is not a loose past report; it marks persistent non-desistance as the trigger for the answer clause. It also repeats the negative pressure of 96:14, moving from failure to know into failure to stop.

topics.headline: negation clips the verb it governs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negator changes both meaning and visible form, making refusal sound clipped before the heavier answer.
topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence identify jussive governance and apocopation of the following verb.

topics.headline: non-desistance is the trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the negation stays inside the protasis: refusal activates the seizure rather than weakening it.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence cleanly separates the negative protasis from the emphatic apodosis.

topics.headline: knowledge failure becomes conduct failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negative question of 96:14 reappear as a negative condition in 96:15.
topics.reason: The boundary echo is concrete and does not alter the local grammar of the negator.

words.gloss_range: to desist or restrain oneself within the negative sworn condition
words.root_gloss_range: root field of forbidding, restraint, endpoint, and restraining reason; local Form VIII selects self-directed desistance
words.prose: {{ar:يَنتَهِ}} ({{tr:yantahi}}) is the condition's hinge: if the same offender does not restrain himself, the answer-clause arrives. Its Form VIII shape turns the root inward, so the one earlier characterized by forbidding at 96:9 is now measured by whether he forbids or restrains himself. The verb is intransitive here, leaving the demanded stopping open over the defiant course exposed in 96:9-14. The root's endpoint pressure also remains felt: if he will not bring himself to a limit, the ayah moves toward an imposed terminus. Its jussive clipped ending makes the idea of stopping audible, and the movement from 96:14 to 96:15 turns failed recognition of divine seeing into a demand for conduct to stop.

topics.headline: the ending enacts stopping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the desistance verb itself end in a clipped form governed by the negator.
topics.reason: The local grammar explicitly marks jussive apocopation after {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}).

topics.headline: no object makes desistance comprehensive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded stopping is not limited to one named object but covers the offender's defiant course.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks this verb instance as intransitive without an explicit object.

topics.headline: non-desistance triggers the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the condition land on this verb immediately before the apodosis, making failed self-restraint the precise trigger.
topics.reason: The clause analysis identifies words 2-5 as the protasis and words 6-9 as the apodosis.

topics.headline: the forbidding root turns inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the earlier forbidding action at 96:9 returns as self-restraint demanded from the offender.
topics.reason: The same-root echo is retained, but local Form VIII and intransitive grammar narrow it to self-directed desistance rather than another external act of forbidding.

topics.headline: restraint carries endpoint pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees desistance as both self-restraint and arrival at a limit, while the local verb still selects stopping rather than a separate noun sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports the root branches of restraint, endpoint, and restraining intellect, but local Form VIII grammar keeps the active sense at desisting or restraining oneself.

topics.headline: the same offender remains in view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same unspoken third-person offender from failed knowledge in 96:14 into the demand for restraint in 96:15.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence licenses the implicit third-person subject as the discourse participant carried forward.

words.gloss_range: answer-lam marking the sworn apodosis before the seizure verb
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) opens the answer side of the sworn condition. It turns from the failed desistance clause to the divine action clause and makes the coming verb the oath's consequence. Its repetition of the first {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la-}}) creates a matched cadence: sworn condition, then sworn answer.

topics.headline: the answer side begins here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seizure clause is the sworn answer to the condition, not a detached future sentence.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks words 6-9 as the apodosis and identifies this prefix as oath-response force.

topics.headline: certainty is fused to action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the oath-answer force attached directly to the seizure verb.
topics.reason: The bound prefix is part of the surface form that opens the emphatic verb.

topics.headline: the structure turns to action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from what he fails to do to what will be done to him.
topics.reason: The prefix begins the apodosis immediately after the desistance verb.

topics.headline: paired prefixes make one sworn frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two matching prefixes bind protasis and apodosis into one oath structure.
topics.reason: The two prefixes have different clause roles but form a local sound and structure echo.

words.gloss_range: emphatic divine action of seizing, striking, scorching, or visibly marking, locally aimed through the following prepositional complement
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes seizure by the forelock, striking, scorching or darkening, visible mark, and weaker reviewed branches; local threat selects violent contact and marking

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the prepositional complement that supplies the forelock as the contact point

words.prose: {{ar:نَسْفَعًۢا}} ({{tr:nasfaʿan}}) is the apodosis pressure point. The first-person plural imperfect brings the divine speaker into the action after the offender has remained the third-person subject of the condition. As Form I, it presents direct divine action rather than a caused or reflexive process. The verb is framed by the answer prefix and energetic ending, so the threat is both sworn and intensified; the heavier energetic-ending variant only increases that acoustic and emphatic weight. Its one-time Quranic root gathers seizure, impact, scorching, blackening, and visible marking, but the following {{ar:بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ}} ({{tr:bi-n-nāṣiyati}}) narrows that force to contact with the forelock. The action therefore answers failed self-restraint with imposed bodily seizure, and the visible marking force answers the divine seeing of 96:14.

topics.headline: third-person offender yields to divine We
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from the offender as subject of refusal to the divine speaker as agent of intervention.
topics.reason: The verb form carries first-person plural subject marking, while the offender remains recoverable from the prior third-person chain.

topics.headline: the complement supplies the contact point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the action aimed through the forelock phrase rather than through an ordinary direct object.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the following prepositional phrase as the governed complement of the verb.

topics.headline: violent contact includes visible marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat is not a pale future action: seizure, impact, scorching, and visible disgrace converge at the named body point.
topics.reason: V4 preserves multiple accepted root branches, while the local prepositional complement narrows them to violent contact at the forelock rather than unrelated reviewed branches.

topics.headline: the verb is formally intensified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the action delivered in a maximally confirmed oath-answer form, with variant evidence showing how heavier ending weight can intensify the same threat.
topics.reason: The local form has answer-prefix plus energetic ending; the heavier-ending variant is retained as emphatic apparatus, not as a new lexical sense.

topics.headline: Form I makes the intervention direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees failed self-restraint answered by direct imposed force at the lexical center of the apodosis.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as Form I imperfect in the apodosis, supporting direct action and threat speech-act force.

topics.headline: sound binds seizure to target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the threat bind desistance, seizure, and forelock while the marking branch makes divine seeing in 96:14 become visible punishment.
topics.reason: The sound rows are surface-tied, and the boundary claim is constrained by accepted mark/darkening senses in the root evidence.

topics.headline: one-time root concentrates the threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this root's force is concentrated in a single Quranic occurrence within this threat.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact root-form as a single occurrence.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the forelock phrase as contact, instrument, or location
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is the hinge that prevents the threat from staying general. It governs the forelock phrase and scopes the action to contact with, by means of, or at that body point. Because the preposition is fused to the definite noun in recitation and spelling, the contact relation is heard and seen as tightly attached. It also changes the previous boundary's epistemic pressure after 96:14 into bodily contact in 96:15.

topics.headline: contact is grammatically fixed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat has a grammatically fixed contact route, not a vague objectless violence.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the preposition as governing the forelock noun as the verb's complement.

topics.headline: handle and location both remain possible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both local choices in view: the forelock can be the handle by which seizure occurs and the place where it lands.
topics.reason: The translation support explicitly flags instrumental versus locative force as a target-language choice while keeping the complement attachment fixed.

topics.headline: recitation joins preposition and target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition and definite target fuse, matching the grammar of contact.
topics.reason: The sound observation follows from the actual surface sequence and supports the attachment already established.

topics.headline: knowledge pressure becomes contact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary move from knowing and seeing in 96:14 to physical grasp in 96:15.
topics.reason: The boundary row is concrete and locally constrained by the preposition's governed body-part complement.

words.gloss_range: the definite forelock or front of the head, governed by the preposition as the precise target of seizure
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes forelock and front hairline, pulling or seizing the forelock, extension of hair, select portion, adjacency, and unrelated plant or pang branches; local noun selects the forelock/front-head branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governing preposition that makes the forelock the complement and contact target

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاصِيَةِ}} ({{tr:an-nāṣiyati}}) lands the threat on a precise body point. Its definiteness and singular form identify the known offender's forelock, and its genitive case shows that it is governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), not a new subject. The forelock is the head's forward, visible point, so the seizure can carry part-whole force: the person, agency, and public dignity are targeted through one leading part. The next ayah repeats the noun indefinitely at 96:16 and describes it, so 96:15 identifies the forelock to be seized and 96:16 supplies its moral label; the ending sound also anticipates the next ayah's closure. The wider forelock-punishment motif at 55:41 remains a parallel, while the local singular keeps attention on this one offender. A dot-change variant can redirect the target toward a different toil-root reading, but the canonical form secures the forelock target, and the movement from 96:14 focuses divine seeing into this exact bodily point.

topics.headline: the known forelock is the governed target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the threat close on one specific, governed forelock rather than an unspecified body part or detached noun.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as definite, singular, genitive, and governed by the preposition.

topics.headline: front point bears agency and humiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the forelock as the leading visible point through which the whole offender's agency and public dignity are seized.
topics.reason: The forelock/front-head branch and active-participle-shaped noun support fronting and leading pressure; this is narrowed to metonymic and cultural force, not a claim that the body part independently acts.

topics.headline: modern brain-center claim exceeds evidence
topics.blocking_evidence: The supplied guardrails support forelock, front of head, and leading-point metonymy, but they do not establish a neuroscience claim about the prefrontal cortex controlling the offender's decisions.
topics.reason: The local lexical evidence is anatomical and metonymic, so the modern cognitive-center reading is an unsupported overextension.

topics.headline: target is described in the next ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 96:15 identify the forelock to be seized and 96:16 immediately describe that same forelock morally.
topics.reason: The immediate repetition at 96:16 is concrete and supported by the QAC note that the next ayah supplies appositive description.

topics.headline: rare forelock field joins punishment motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare concrete forelock field has a punishment parallel at 55:41, while this ayah narrows the motif to the head's leading point.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles mark the field as low-occurrence, and the 55:41 parallel is concrete but does not override the local singular target.

topics.headline: variant shows target is graphically delicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the canonical dotting secures the forelock target, while the variant remains apparatus and does not govern the local parse.
topics.reason: The local canonical noun is aligned as the forelock root; the graphic variant can illustrate contrast but not replace the local target.

topics.headline: sound and sight focus on the target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the noun tie into the next ayah's ending sound and sees divine sight from 96:14 focus into an exact bodily target.
topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to the actual final noun, and the boundary row is constrained by the concrete governed target.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. The wrongful restrainer is commanded to reach his endpoint or be seized by the front. Evidence: `ن ه ي B001` ceasing/restraint, `ن ه ي B002` endpoint/limit, `س ف ع B001` seizing by forelock, `ن ص ي B001` forelock and taking by it. Structural cue: `لم ينته` reverses 96:9 `ينهى`; the one who forbade must now desist. Mechanism: illegitimate restraint triggers legitimate coercive restraint at the body's leading point. Abductive move: the packet supplies the root reversal and the forelock seizure branches; I infer retaliatory symmetry. Reading change: the threat reads as a precise reversal of his action, not generic punishment.

2. `نسفعاً` also activates discoloration/scorching, turning moral exposure into a visible mark. Evidence: `س ف ع B002` reddish blackness, `س ف ع B003` scorching by fire/hot wind, `ع ل م B002` mark/sign, `ر ء ي B006` visible appearance. Structural cue: 96:14 says Allah sees; 96:15 makes something visible on the front. Mechanism: hidden denial becomes a marked, darkened front. Abductive move: the packet gives color/scorch branches; I infer that seizing may include visible shaming. Reading change: the ayah reads both as physical grasp and as public marking/exposure.

3. The forelock activates control over direction. Evidence: `ن ص ي B001` figurative control by taking the forelock; `ه د ي B003` leading front part; `و ل ي B006/B007` turning toward/away. Structural cue: the one who turned away is threatened at the front of movement. Mechanism: taking the forelock arrests the body's false direction and reassigns control. Abductive move: the packet supplies front/leading and turning branches; I infer a directional-control mechanism. Reading change: `بالناصية` becomes the point where misguided agency is physically overruled.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 96:19 made the forelock seizure contrast with voluntary prostration: one head/front is dragged down by force, the other lowers itself in obedience. The surprise is that the same bodily lowering can be humiliation or nearness depending on obedience.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The restrainer made the one who must cease.** `ن ه ي:B001` supplies both restraining another and ceasing oneself. The earlier finite roles reverse across 96:9 and 96:15: the one who `ينهى` a servant is now the subject of `لم ينته`. The root’s role is juridical symmetry, turning his imposed restraint back upon him as a required self-restraint. The packet supplies the morphological recurrence; I infer that the reversal is corrective. The line reads as a transfer of the stopping command from the servant to the controller.

2. **An externally supplied endpoint.** `ن ه ي:B002` supplies the endpoint, edge, or limit reached by a thing. The conditional says that if the actor does not bring his conduct to an end, forelock seizure follows. The endpoint branch makes the threat functionally exact: refusal to stop internally produces an imposed terminus. The packet supplies the conditional sequence; I infer the causal arrow from non-cessation to enforced limit. `ينته` therefore concerns both moral cessation and who controls the action’s endpoint.

3. **Capture at the bodily point of control.** `س ف ع:B001` supplies coercive seizure by the forelock, and `ن ص ي:B001` supplies both the forelock and figurative control through taking it. Their immediate combination removes lexical ambiguity: one root supplies the force and the other the handle and control relation. I infer that bodily capture enacts loss of agency rather than merely accompanying it. The threat thus reads as a concrete reversal of the antagonist’s effort to control another’s worship.

4. **Seizing the social vanguard as well as the head.** `ن ص ي:B003` supplies the chosen elite, noble leaders, or front rank. The next lines characterize the forelock, then let the actor summon his council (96:16–17); a counter-summons follows in 96:18. The elite branch makes the forelock the social “front” of his authority, not only hair. I infer metonymic extension from bodily front to leadership. The threat can therefore announce collapse of a whole prestige structure at its leading point.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 96:16 made the threatened forelock a morally qualified locus of agency rather than a neutral body-part. 96:17–18 then activated `ن ص ي:B003`: the seized “front” is also the leading edge of a council-based power formation answered by another force. Finally, 96:19’s voluntary lowering completed the reversal between imposed capture and chosen submission.

baseline.text: Hayır! Eğer vazgeçmezse onu perçeminden mutlaka sürükleyeceğiz.

findings.text: Başkalarını durduran kişi bu kez durması gereken kişi yapılır; aynı sınırlama kökü haksız engeli sahibine geri çevirir.
Kişi kendi isteğiyle son vermezse davranışına dışarıdan zorunlu bir bitiş konur; artık eylemin sonunu kimin belirleyeceği söz konusudur.
Perçemden yakalama, başkasının ibadetini denetlemek isteyen kişiyi bedenindeki yön ve denetim noktasından ele geçirerek iradesini tersine çevirir.
Perçem, kişinin başıyla birlikte topluluğa dayalı iktidarının ön safını da temsil eder; yakalama tehdidi bu saygınlık düzenini önder noktasından çökertir.
Yakalama fiilinin karartma ve kavurma çağrışımları, zorla ele geçirmenin aynı zamanda suçu bedende görünür kılan kamusal bir damga olabileceğini düşündürür.
Perçemden zorla aşağı çekilme, son ayette başın isteyerek secdeye indirilmesinin karşıtıdır; bedensel alçalma itaate göre ya aşağılanma ya yakınlık olur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something hidden or unknown becomes apprehensible through instruction, perception, inquiry, indication, or controlled disclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel extends from pedagogy and eyesight to banners, landmarks, appointments, and verification procedures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, Pupil, and Sustained Regard
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Detection begins with the eye, focuses through the dark pupil, and can settle into a prolonged, quiet gaze.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visual perception `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; dark pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; sustained gaze `س ج د:B005/m01`; dark-red or black tinge `س ف ع:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is an optical mechanism rather than a generic cognition cluster: an object is detected, received in the pupil, and held under an unbroken gaze. The chromatic branch sharpens the concrete blackness through which sight is imagined.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Form emerges through creation, measurement, cutting, smoothing, differentiation, and completion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same formative logic reaches mirrors, pared edges, cleft surfaces, raised slabs, and solid barriers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measuring, Paring, and Cutting to Fit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A desired measure is established and hard material is pared or clipped until it conforms.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: estimation and measure `خ ل ق:B001/m01`; paring to level `ق ل م:B001/m01`; cutting shears `ق ل م:B006/m01`; bounded amount `ن ه ي:B010/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Measurement supplies the intended form, paring removes excess, and shears perform the controlled separation. The terminal amount defines when shaping is complete.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is regulated by command, moral inhibition, willing submission, refusal, and coercive enforcement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Regulation extends from conscience and repentance to repulsion, striking, enslavement, and submission at an endpoint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Command and Moral Inhibition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An authority imposes a requirement, while reason and protective restraint inhibit a prohibited act.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: binding command `ء م ر:B002/m01`; prohibition `ن ه ي:B001/m01`; morally restraining reason `ن ه ي:B003/m01`; protective restraint `و ق ي:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Command supplies positive direction, prohibition blocks an opposing action, and reason internalizes the restraint. Protection frames inhibition as preservation rather than mere stoppage.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is regulated by command, moral inhibition, willing submission, refusal, and coercive enforcement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Regulation extends from conscience and repentance to repulsion, striking, enslavement, and submission at an endpoint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Refusal, Turning Away, and Transgression
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject crosses a limit, refuses direction, and turns away from an imposed or recognized claim.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: moral excess `ط غ ي:B001/m01`; refusal and retreat `و ل ي:B007/m01`; crossing the correct boundary `خ ط ء:B001/m01`; rejected prohibition `ن ه ي:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Transgression is a boundary crossing, refusal is a directional reversal, and turning away gives that reversal a bodily image. Prohibition remains the limit against which the refusal is legible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is regulated by command, moral inhibition, willing submission, refusal, and coercive enforcement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Regulation extends from conscience and repentance to repulsion, striking, enslavement, and submission at an endpoint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Forelock Seizure and Repulsive Force
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An offending person is seized at the forelock, physically driven back, and struck or restrained.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: forelock seizure `س ف ع:B001/m01`; grasped forelock `ن ص ي:B001/m01`; repulsion `ز ب ن:B001/m01`; striking `س ف ع:B004/m01`; enforced stoppage `ن ه ي:B001/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The forelock supplies the point of control, repulsion supplies directed force, and striking supplies enforcement. The lexical scene concretizes moral restraint as capture and bodily displacement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is regulated by command, moral inhibition, willing submission, refusal, and coercive enforcement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Regulation extends from conscience and repentance to repulsion, striking, enslavement, and submission at an endpoint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wrongdoing, Return, and Desistance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wrong is recognized, the actor turns back from it, and pursuit of the former course ceases.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sinful error `خ ط ء:B002/m01`; repentance and reversal `ر ج ع:B003/m01`; desistance `ن ه ي:B007/m01`; turning away from a course `و ل ي:B007/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Error establishes the defective course, return reverses its direction, and desistance prevents renewed pursuit. The same turning image can therefore express culpable refusal or corrective repentance according to its object.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: People become a public body by gathering, calling, deliberating, assigning rank, or dispersing into absence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The social field includes multitudes, empty dwellings, intimate retainers, court privilege, leadership, and delegated office.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Elite, Leader, and Court Intimate
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A selected person advances at the front, gains privileged proximity, and serves as an intimate of power.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: chosen elite `ن ص ي:B003/m01`; leading front `ه د ي:B003/m01`; court favorite `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; intimate confidant `ء ن س:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Selection differentiates the elite, precedence gives that person a leading position, and nearness to authority becomes court privilege. Intimacy describes the social access produced by rank.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations are organized by direction, distance, contact, return, succession, and arrival at a limit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spatial nearness expands into bodily facing, residence, temporal imminence, race order, and goal attainment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Endpoint and Attainment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Movement proceeds toward a terminal boundary that can be reached, possessed, or completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: endpoint `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; terminal limit `ن ه ي:B002/m01`; goal attainment `و ل ي:B012/m01`; imminent completion `ق ر ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Endpoint defines the boundary, imminence describes the approach, and attainment names successful arrival. The same structure supports spatial, temporal, and purposive completion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on fitness, acquired capacity, effort, provision, and the point at which need is adequately met.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes vocation, beginning a task, food need, subsistence fodder, surety, and voluntary exertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Adequacy and Independence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Provision reaches a sufficient level, further seeking stops, and the possessor experiences independence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: adequacy `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; sufficient endpoint `ن ه ي:B005/m01`; independence `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; cessation of seeking `ن ه ي:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Adequacy names the threshold, cessation marks its behavioral effect, and independence names the resulting social condition. The surface warns that perceived independence can also misrecognize continuing dependence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water descends, surges, gathers, is drawn or carried, and turns ground into pasture and ripened growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hydrological scene includes cloud cover, seasonal rain, terminal pools, wells, pulleys, waterskins, herd watering, and overripe fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Flood, Gathering Water, and Terminal Pool
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water rises beyond bounds, flows with force, and settles where the channel terminates.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: overpowering flood `ط غ ي:B002/m01`; water exceeding its limit `ط غ و:B002/m01`; terminal pool `ن ه ي:B004/m01`; gathered great water `ع ل م:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ط غ ي` 96:6; `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `ن ه ي` 96:9, 96:15; `ع ل م` 96:4-5, 96:14
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Excess and force describe the moving flood, while the terminal pool supplies its endpoint. The gathered-water motif scales the result from a local basin to a broad body of water.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water descends, surges, gathers, is drawn or carried, and turns ground into pasture and ripened growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hydrological scene includes cloud cover, seasonal rain, terminal pools, wells, pulleys, waterskins, herd watering, and overripe fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain-Fed Pasture and Plant Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fertile rain prepares soil, plants emerge, and pasture becomes available to grazing animals.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile rain and soil `ك ر م:B002/m01`; general plant growth `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; fodder grass `ن ص ي:B004/m01`; camel pasture `ص ل و:B009/m01`; herb outside the main stock `ق ل م:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rain changes the condition of the soil, plant motifs specify the resulting vegetation, and pasture gives that growth an ecological consumer. The stray herb preserves diversity within the field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Internal condition becomes legible through breath, blood, pain, bodily marks, weakness, or fullness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes lung disease, epidemic terrain, menstruation, leech treatment, cleft tissue, flank pain, hip sockets, and corpulence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Belly, Flank, Back, and Hip Pain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pain is localized by adjacent anatomical regions and the joints that bear movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: abdominal pang `ن ص ي:B006/m01`; flank `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; back and side `ص ل و:B005/m01`; hip socket `ك ر م:B007/m01`; hoof-protective response to pain `و ق ي:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The pang supplies sensation, flank and back supply location, and the hip socket supplies a load-bearing joint. Hoof protection extends the same pain-to-compensation process into animal biomechanics.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Internal condition becomes legible through breath, blood, pain, bodily marks, weakness, or fullness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes lung disease, epidemic terrain, menstruation, leech treatment, cleft tissue, flank pain, hip sockets, and corpulence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Strength, Fullness, and Corpulence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sustained nourishment becomes bodily firmness and reaches a terminal fullness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bodily strength `ع ب د:B007/m01`; extreme fatness `ن ه ي:B006/m01`; animal of noble lineage `ن د و:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Strength names functional capacity, fatness names accumulated bodily reserve, and noble lineage provides the husbandry setting in which fullness is read as condition and value.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dyed, Iridescent, and Deceptive Cloth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cloth is dyed or woven with changing color, fitted to the body, and made capable of overstating its quality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dyed garment `س ف ع:B007/m01`; deceptive cloth `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`; iridescent fabric `ق ل م:B010/m01`; small bodice `ع ل ق:B015/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Dye and iridescence create visual attraction, the bodice gives the fabric bodily placement, and deceptive appearance explains how surface can claim a value the material does not possess.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tattoo, Dark Trace, and Repeated Line
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A line is repeatedly inscribed into a surface and darkened until it becomes a durable identifying trace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: repeated tattoo line `ر ج ع:B009/m01`; black-red coloration `س ف ع:B002/m02`; pathlike trace `ن د ي:B013/m01`; distinguishing mark `ع ل م:B002/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ر ج ع` 96:8; `س ف ع` 96:15; `ن د ي` has no separate surface token; `ع ل م` 96:4-5, 96:14
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Repetition lays down the line, coloration makes it visible, and the resulting trace acquires identifying force. The scene links inscription and bodily marking without collapsing either into generic writing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hair, Forelock, and Grooming
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hair is lengthened, combed, trimmed, or grasped at the front of the head.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: combed long hair `ن ص ي:B002/m01`; trimming `ق ل م:B001/m03`; forelock `ن ص ي:B001/m02`; grasping the forelock `س ف ع:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Growth and combing describe care, trimming controls form, and grasping changes the groomed forelock into a point of domination. The surface punishment scene therefore touches a broader bodily-adornment system.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animals are identified, pursued, trapped, nourished, bred, and tracked through characteristic motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel contains snares, raptors, shrikes, hyenas, lambs, herds, migration, halted flight, racing order, and hoof care.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Raptors, Shrikes, and Foraging
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Predatory birds range over a food field and secure the subsistence on which they live.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; shrike `و ق ي:B005/m01`; subsistence portion `ع ل ق:B006/m02`; fodder plant `ن ص ي:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The named birds supply agents, pasture supplies hunting terrain, and subsistence supplies the functional outcome. The channel is ecological rather than a simple list of species.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Goods, land, and chances are divided by counting, weighing, approximation, selection, and reciprocal transfer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes lottery arrows, measured amounts, ounces, resale, image-bearing coins, and territorial sections.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Amount, Approximation, and Weight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A quantity is estimated, bounded, and expressed through a recognized unit of weight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m02`; approximate amount `ق ر ب:B016/m01`; numerical extent `ن ه ي:B010/m01`; ounce weight `و ق ي:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Estimation proposes a value, approximation admits a range, numerical extent sets a bound, and the ounce supplies a conventional standard.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material or circumstance is overtaken by force, producing controlled transformation, scorching, collapse, or calamity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel contrasts cooking and aromatic preparation with destructive heat, cascading ruin, bodily breakdown, doom, and public disgrace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Scorch and Defensive Shelter
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire or hot wind strikes the body or material, creating a need for protective enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: scorching blast `س ف ع:B003/m01`; exposure to fire `ص ل و:B001/m01`; self-protection `و ق ي:B002/m01`; blackened tinge `س ف ع:B002/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The blast is the agent, exposure is the contact, darkening is the visible result, and shelter is the compensating response.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir eylemi yasaklayıp engelleme ile kişinin yasaklanan şeyden geri durmasını ve insanların kötülükten birbirini alıkoymasını birlikte doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam eylemi durdurmaya yöneliktir; bitiş noktası, akıl veya su birikintisi anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yasaklama anlamını korur; vazgeçme, benliği tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme yalnızca kanıtlanan yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi bir eylemden yasaklayarak, engelleyerek veya uyararak alıkoymak; ilgili yapılarda yasaklanan eylemden geri durmak ya da insanların birbirini kötülükten alıkoymasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin yapılmasını yasaklama, engelleme veya caydırma yoluyla durdurma.
Yasaklanan veya istenmeyen eylemden geri durma ve kendini tutma.
Bir topluluğun kötülük karşısında üyelerini karşılıklı olarak engellemesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, buyruğun karşıtı olan yasaklamayı, bir şeyi yaptırmamak için engellemeyi ve bunun sonucunda geri durmayı aynı çekirdek çevresinde birleştirir; karşılıklı engelleme bu çekirdeğin topluluk içindeki kullanımını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: bir eylemi yasaklama, engelleme veya ondan geri durma
concept_gloss.applicability: Yasaklayan kişi, engellenen kişi ve karşılıklı engelleme yapılarını kapsayan genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yasaklama, engelleme ve geri durma yönlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiyi belirli bir eylemden men ettiği etkin kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Etkin yasaklama ve engelleme hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendiliğinden geri durmasını ve karşılıklı engellemeyi kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yasaklanan eylemden geri durmayı ve insanların birbirini karşılıklı olarak engellemesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Azarlama ve sertçe geri çevirme biçimini özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir davranışı önlemeye ve kişiyi o davranıştan döndürmeye yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği genel yasaklama ve geri durmadır; komşu dal ise engellemenin azarlama biçimini daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sesli bir çıkış gerektirmeyen yasaklama, kendini tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sesle azarlama, kovma veya hayvanı ve başka varlıkları sesle yöneltme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir hareketi durdurmak için caydırıcı müdahaleyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalda sesli azarlama kurucu bir özelliktir; odak dalda yasaklama ses biçimine bağlı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini eylemden alıkoyma hareketini ve o eylemden geri durmayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin yapılmasının hükmen veya dokunulmazlık bakımından yasak oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapılmaması gereken davranışlar alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yasaklama eylemidir; komşu dal ise eylemin yasak statüsünü ve izin verilmezliğini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şeyin ulaştığı son sınırı temel alır; haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılması bu çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısı, burun bağının ucu ise somut ve dar bir uzmanlaşmadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel son sınırı içerir, ancak ulaştırma eylemi ile belirli bağ ucu çekirdekle eş düzeyli bağımsız anlamlar sayılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın son ve sınır anlamı ile yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen ulaştırma ve bağ ucu kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilerleyişinin veya uzanışının vardığı son nokta ya da sınırdır; ilgili yapılarda bir haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılmasını, özel bir kullanımda da devenin burun bağının ucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin ulaştığı son nokta, uç veya sınır.
Haber veya ok gibi bir şeyi amaçlanan alıcıya ya da hedefe ulaştırma.
Devenin burnundaki bağın uç bölümü.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, varılan son sınırı ana anlam olarak verir; bildirme ve gönderme yapılarında bir şeyi son hedefine ulaştırma, ayrıca belirli bir hayvan bağının uç kısmı bu uzanıştan türeyen kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.text: son noktaya varma veya bir şeyi hedefine ulaştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Son sınır çekirdeği ile ulaştırma uzantısını birlikte anlatır; özel bağ ucu kullanımı bağlamda ayrıca belirtilir.

error_profile.preserves: Son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırma arasındaki yönlü bağı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kendi son noktasına vardığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Varılan son nokta ve hedef yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi alıcıya ulaştırma eylemini ve bağ ucunu dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Son sınır çekirdeği büyük ölçüde örtüşür; odak dal ulaştırma ve bağ ucu uzantılarıyla, komşu dal ise derece ve uzaklık kapsamıyla ayrılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi alıcıya veya hedefe ulaştırmayı ve somut bir bağ ucunu da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da şeyin sona vardığı sınırı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal zaman ve mesafe boyunca uzanan sürecin sonuna odaklanır; odak dal daha genel son nokta yanında ulaştırma uzantısı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İlerleyişin vardığı son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de bir şeyin ötesine geçilmeyen sınır düşüncesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal varış ve bitiş noktasını, komşu dal ise ayırma ve sınırlandırma işlevini temel alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı, sahibini çirkin ve uygunsuz davranıştan alıkoyan düşünme gücü olarak açıkça tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada yalnızca zihinsel yeti değil, davranışı frenleyen ayırt etme ve özdenetim işlevi kurucudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adlandırmalar frenleyici aklı gösterir; bir kişide böyle bir engelleyici bulunmadığını söyleyen kullanım yalnızca kendi yapısına bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kötü, çirkin veya uygunsuz davranışı ayırt edip kendini ondan alıkoymasını sağlayan akıl ve sağduyu yetisidir.

facets.statement: Kötü davranışı tanıyıp kişiyi onu yapmaktan alıkoyan akıl.
Bir kişide onu durduracak akıl veya iç engel bulunup bulunmadığını belirtme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, bu akıl anlayışını soyut bilgi birikiminden çok, sahibini kötü davranıştan alıkoyan ayırt etme ve kendini denetleme gücü olarak ortaklaşa sunar.

concept_gloss.text: kötü davranışı önleyen akıl ve sağduyu
concept_gloss.applicability: Davranışsal frenleme işlevinin kurucu olduğu bütün dal kullanımlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl, ayırt etme ve kötülükten alıkoyma işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişide davranışını frenleyecek zihinsel yetinin bulunup bulunmadığı söylenirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Davranışı frenleyen sağduyu işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dalın genel akıl adı olarak kullanımını tek başına karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sahibini yapılmaması gerekenden alıkoyan akıl ve sağduyuyu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kanıttaki çekirdek ve davranışsal sınır aynıdır; yayımlanabilir bir anlam ayrımı görünmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kötü davranışı engelleme işlevini anlamın zorunlu merkezi yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilme, anlama, ayırt etme ve zihinde kavrama gibi daha geniş bilişsel işlevleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aklı, ayırt etmeyi ve yanlış davranış karşısında kendini tutmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal davranışsal freni zorunlu tutar; komşu dalın akıl alanı bilgi ve kavrayışı da bağımsız olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Davranışı ayırt edip frenleyen sağlam zihinsel denetimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Akıl ve ağırbaşlılık eksikliğini, görüş karışıklığını ve kötü yönetimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin doğru yargılama ve davranışını yönetme kapasitesini değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal frenleyici aklın varlığını, komşu dal aynı eksende akıl ve ağırbaşlılık yetersizliğini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, suyun veya selin vadi sonunda ulaşıp durduğu, sakinleştiği ve biriktiği yeri ortak bir mekansal süreç olarak doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sıradan her su birikintisi değil, akışın son bulup suyun durulduğu doğal yer ve bu durulma süreci kastedilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gölcük adları ile suyun durması ve vadinin son kesimi için kullanılan yapılar ayrı yüzeyler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Akan suyun veya selin vadi sonunda ulaşıp durulduğu, yayıldığı ve biriktiği doğal gölcük ya da kesimdir; ilgili yapıda suyun burada durup sakinleşmesini de anlatır.

facets.statement: Akışın sonunda suyun durulup biriktiği doğal gölcük.
Vadi içinde sel sularının son bulup yayılarak sakinleştiği kesim.
Suyun gölcükte durması ve hareketini yitirerek sakinleşmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, suyun akış sonunda bir gölcüğe veya vadi kesimine varmasını, orada yayılıp durmasını ve birikmesini tek bir yer-süreç bağı içinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: akış sonunda suyun durulup biriktiği yer
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem doğal gölcüğü hem vadi sonundaki birikme kesimini karşılar; süreç kullanımında durulma ayrıca belirtilir.

error_profile.preserves: Akış sonu, durulma, birikme ve yer ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun gölcüğe varıp hareketini yitirdiği süreç anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun durması, sakinleşmesi ve birikmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gölcüğün veya vadi kesiminin yer adı olma yönünü karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da suyun bir yerde toplanıp hareketsiz kalmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğal akışın sonundaki gölcüktür; komşu dal suyun kaldığı doğal veya yapay kabı daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Vadi veya sel akışının sona erdiği konumu ve suyun burada durulmasını içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın ayırıcı niteliği suyu tutmasıdır; odak dalınki akan suyun burada sona erip sakinleşmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suyun durulup biriktiği gölcüğü veya yayılma kesimini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal vadi sonları ve suyun izlediği aşağı kesimlerle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda suyun durup birikmesi kurucudur; komşu dalda son yatak veya akış yolu olmak yeterlidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli övgü kalıplarında bir erkek veya kadının yeterliliğinin başka birini aramaya gerek bırakmamasını açıkça bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnızca verilen değerlendirme kalıplarına bağlıdır; kökün yalın ve genel bir yeterlilik anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişiyi öven ve başkasını aratmayacak yeterliliği bildiren kalıpla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir övgü kalıbında, bir kişinin nitelik ve yeterliliğinin başkasını aramaya gerek bırakmayacak düzeye ulaşmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin başkasını aratmayacak ölçüde yeterli ve doyurucu bulunması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, kalıbın bir kişiyi yalnızca yeterli saymadığını, onun niteliğinin başka birini arama isteğini sona erdirecek kadar güçlü olduğunu ortaklaşa gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yeterlilik ile başka arayışı sona erdirme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üstün yeterliliğini doğal konuşma içinde övmek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Övgüyü ve başka birini arama gereğini kaldıran yeterliliği korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yalnızca belirli hayvan adlarıyla kurulan yapılarda hayvanın semizlik ve irilik bakımından en ileri düzeye ulaşmasını doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel semizlik değil, dişi veya kesimlik devenin çok semiz ve iri oluşunu bildiren sınırlı niteleme söz konusudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtlanan deve nitelemelerine bağlı tutulur ve köke yalın bir semizlik anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Dişi veya kesimlik devenin semizlik bakımından en ileri düzeye varmış, çok iri ve dolgun olmasını bildiren niteleme yapısıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli deve türlerinin semizlikte en ileri düzeye ulaşması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, hayvanın sıradan biçimde etli olmasından daha güçlü bir dereceyi, semizliğin son sınırına varmayı ve kesimlik deve kullanımında buna eşlik eden iriliği gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: semizliğin doruğuna ulaşmış deve

facets.statement: Şişeler veya cam eşya için aktarılan adlandırma.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü koyu rengi, kimi anlatımlarda ona karışan kızıllığı ve bu rengin insan, hayvan, ocak taşı, yer izi veya öfkeli yüz üzerinde görülmesini birlikte destekler. Dal korunabilir, ancak yalın renk niteliği ile belirli söz öbeklerindeki uygulamalar aynı düzeyde tek bir anlammış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, kızıllık karışabilen koyu renktir; öfkeli yüz, yanak, kuş, ocak taşı ve yer izi bu rengin görüldüğü ayrı uygulama alanlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın renk bildiren biçimler çekirdeği taşır; öfkeli yüz, koyu yanak ve yer iziyle kurulan söz öbekleri ise yalnızca kendi bağlamlarına bağlı uygulamalar olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Temel anlam, kimi zaman hafif kızıllık taşıyan siyah ya da koyu renktir. Bu nitelik insan ve hayvan görünüşüne, ateş görmüş taşlara, yer izlerine ve öfkeyle yüze çöken renge uygulanabilir.

facets.statement: Renk özü, yalın siyahlık veya içine kızıllık karışmış ince bir koyuluktur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar koyu rengi ortak çekirdek sayar; bazıları kızıllık karışımını daha belirgin kılar ve insan, hayvan, ocak taşı, yer izi ile öfkeli yüzdeki görünüşü bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

facets.statement: Alındaki saç sınırı ya da ön saçın çıktığı yer, dalın bedensel çekirdeğidir.
Bir kişiyi ön saç bölgesinden kavramak ve çekmek, bedensel çekirdekten türeyen eylem anlamıdır.
İki kişinin birbirinin ön saçından tutup çekişmesi, eylemin karşılıklı gerçekleşen biçimidir.
Bir şeyin ön kısmından tutma görüntüsü, belirli bir söz öbeğinde onun üzerinde denetim ve söz sahibi olmayı anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun ya da şeyin en iyi ve önde gelen kesimini, bu kesimi seçmeyi ve bir kişinin topluluğunun önderi sayılmasını anlatır. Kimi kullanımlarda yalnızca geride kalan bölüm, önden gidenler veya üst konumdaki bir kesimden evlenme anlamı taşır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun ya da herhangi bir şeyin en iyi ve seçkin kesimi, dalın temel adlandırmasıdır.
Bir şey içinden en iyi olanı seçip almak, adlandırmayla bağlantılı eylem çekirdeğidir.

Bir topluluğun en yüksek konumdaki kesiminden evlenmek, seçkinlik çekirdeğine bağlı özel bir toplumsal kullanımdır.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.
